title: Top spenders
hints: Track the running total on the account itself: add an `outgoing: int = 0` field and bump it inside `transfer`, only on the success path.
Keeping the total up to date at write time makes the query a simple sort — no need to replay a transaction log.
Sort with a tuple key so both orderings happen in one pass: `key=lambda item: (-item[1].outgoing, item[0])`.
`sorted(self.accounts.items(), key=...)[:n]`, then format each with `f"{account_id}({account.outgoing})"`. Slicing past the end of a list is safe.
